title: In This Town — Pigeon for Mayor

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: In this town, everybody parties. Even the pigeons.
beats.visual: Crane down the party street; on 'Even the pigeons' cut to three party-hat pigeons bobbing on a lamp-post head.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Except me.
beats.visual: Next lamp post: OUR pigeon alone, no hat, 'determined', turns his head to the lens.

beats.speaker: pigeon
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: Pigeon 'huss' puffs on the lamp post, cut per HUSS; partygoers below glance up.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: They did a conga at my birthday. Without me.
beats.visual: Six party-hat pigeons strut a conga loop around a birthday cake; on 'Without me.' cut to our pigeon alone at the park stone table.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: So I'm running for mayor.
beats.visual: Park, push in. A VOTE PIGEON sign pops up beside him on 'mayor'. Face 'smug'.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: If you can't beat them, sit on their car. My uncle.

card.quote: If you can't beat them, sit on their car.

beats.visual: QUOTE CARD until 'My uncle.'; reveal: an older pigeon sitting smugly on the roof of a parked car.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: While they're out partying, by the way, I'm knocking on their doors.
beats.visual: Dark house front, pigeon 'knock' at a big front door. Nobody answers.

beats.speaker: pigeon
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: One door per HUSS, counter DOORS: 1, 2, 3, 117, 399, 400. Last door: BACK AFTER THE PARTY sign.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: He who honks first, honks loudest. A goose, under oath.

card.quote: He who honks first, honks loudest.

beats.visual: QUOTE CARD, attribution appears on 'A goose, under oath.'

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: I rehearsed my speech ten thousand times.
beats.visual: Bedroom, pigeon on the desk at a tiny mic, counter 9,997. The cat loafs on the bed, unimpressed.

beats.speaker: pigeon
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: HUSS into the tiny mic; counter 9,998 → 9,999 → 10,000. The cat switches to 'stare'.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Then came the Summer Party Election.
beats.visual: Square at dusk, banner SUMMER PARTY / ELECTION / VOTE!, packed bleachers.

beats.speaker: mayor
beats.text: Party!
beats.visual: Mayor at the stage mic, both arms up, confetti, crowd cheers.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: My speech.
beats.visual: Pigeon on a stack of books in front of the lowered mic. Crowd settles.

beats.speaker: pigeon
beats.text: Coo.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up: one flat 'Coo.' into the mic.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Silence. A balloon fainted.
beats.visual: Wide: everyone 'stunned'. One balloon sinks, wobbles and flops onto the stage.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Top ten respectful moments. Number seven: the mayor gave me his hat.
beats.visual: TOP 10 card; '#7' on 'seven'; the mayor lowers his top hat onto the pigeon; it swallows him, feet showing.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Numbers one to six? Also me.
beats.visual: Card flips #6 → #1, each with the hat. Feet tap smugly.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: I won. The cat voted for himself.
beats.visual: Scoreboard PIGEON 1,203 | MAYOR 0 | CAT 1, confetti; cut to the cat alone in an empty bleacher row.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: First law: no more parties.
beats.visual: Hat at the mic; banner flips to NO MORE / PARTIES; crowd 'shocked'.

beats.speaker: town
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: Three bedrooms, one per HUSS: grandad, Marcus, Brenda grinding with a dumbbell / slam.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: No parties means no crumbs.
beats.visual: The top hat (feet only) struts down the empty quiet street and pecks a clean paving stone: nothing.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: The moon is just a big crumb. Me, hungry.

card.quote: The moon is just a big crumb.

beats.visual: Pigeon peeks under the brim at the moon; QUOTE CARD.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Now everybody grinds. Except me.
beats.visual: A single lamp pool on the empty street: the hat with a tiny party hat bounces next to a speaker and the cake.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Don't tell the mayor.
beats.visual: The hat lifts; the pigeon peeks out, 'wink', crumb on his beak. End.
